title: Science Museum
visualBrief: Science Museum connected exterior on its actual long mapped footprint: giant Ionic-columned pale stone Exhibition Road frontage and three real recessed lower entrances, stepped cornice/parapet, repeated tall paired-level glazing, rear clerestory/flat roof blocks, long red-brick gallery range with restrained roof lanterns and western modern grey/glazed block. Source silhouette follows the complete mapped east-to-west museum, not only its street facade. Adjacent north mapped buildings, Natural History Museum, separate links and Imperial College remain independent. No copied lettering, temporary banners, furnished galleries, vehicles/art collections or neighboring green barrel-roof building.

sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Picture-led medium-fi exterior. The unqualified11m map height is not a surveyed envelope. Working front roof26m, giant columns8.1..23.2m, parapet27.1m, roof clerestory/service blocks to30m, long gallery range19m and western block25m with low rooftop plant. Fourteen simplified Ionic columns and bay counts, facade recesses, roof forms/equipment and modern cladding are approximate. Front2020 photograph and ordinary2011 aerial establish recognizable form/colors; the older aerial is used with current map coverage, not as proof of exact current equipment. Opaque exterior glass proxies; no interior galleries, copied collections/text, exhibition banners or adjacent buildings. Three sets of2/3/4 short reconstructed0.18m approach treads bridge the approximate original-ground threshold grade; these are not surveyed historic stairs.
